components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Orange action for the next operator step.
components.css: .btn-primary { background: oklch(0.61 0.16 43); color: oklch(0.14 0.018 35); border: 1px solid oklch(0.61 0.16 43); border-radius: 5px; min-height: 42px; font-weight: 650; } .btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.60 0.16 43); color: oklch(0.08 0.015 35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action on the raised neutral surface.
components.css: .btn-secondary { background: oklch(0.95 0.012 170); color: oklch(0.22 0.025 178); border: 1px solid oklch(0.87 0.018 170); border-radius: 5px; min-height: 42px; } .btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.012 170); color: oklch(0.22 0.025 178); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White input with a clear slate border and orange focus ring.
components.css: input, select, textarea { background: white; color: oklch(0.22 0.025 178); border: 1px solid oklch(0.79 0.018 225); border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 43px; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.61 0.16 43 / .24); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Dark green navigation with readable light links and a raised selected state.
components.css: .v2-nav { background: oklch(0.22 0.035 177); color: oklch(0.98 0.008 92); } .v2-nav a:hover { color: white; background: oklch(1 0 0 / .07); } .v2-nav a.selected { background: oklch(0.29 0.04 177); }

narrative.overview: A self-hosted operator interface that keeps configuration, test evidence, and active state easy to distinguish. A cool green-tinted neutral workspace supports long setup tasks; forest green anchors navigation, while orange is reserved for primary actions. The layout stays practical and responsive, with technical values rendered plainly and results kept temporary.
keyCharacteristics: Cool green-tinted neutral workspace with forest-green navigation
Orange primary actions with dark, high-contrast text
Clear separation between draft, test, and active configuration
Responsive forms and searchable model selection
Temporary test evidence without retained audio or transcript logs

rules.name: The Action Orange Rule
rules.body: Use orange for primary operator actions and selected progress states; retain readable dark text at hover.

rules.name: The State Clarity Rule
rules.body: Keep draft, test outcome, and active revision visibly distinct.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive control has a visible keyboard focus indicator.

dos: Use forest green for navigation and restrained teal for status.
Keep primary action hover text at WCAG AA contrast.
Keep functional navigation text at or above 11px on narrow screens.
Use literal text for model IDs and test output.
donts: Do not hide the difference between a saved draft and the active revision.
Do not retain audio or transcript content in diagnostic traces.
Do not use low-contrast hover colors for buttons or navigation.
